author: CC
prose: Orchestrator ask, 2026-11-12: test_install_lays_the_journal_merge_driver.py was 3 of 5 red on akiendell. Tooth 2 expected an unquoted PYTHONPATH=<repo> but the artifact tool writes it through shlex.quote, so a Windows path reads PYTHONPATH='C:...'. Tooth 3 wrote its stale driver string unquoted, so the installer's shlex.split stripped the backslashes and the detail read 'points at another checkout' instead of naming the gone interpreter. Tooth 5 expected '] journal-merge-driver:' in the dry run's output, but since ticket bdd0ed77930f the dry run prints only reds, and the step is green on a configured box. The installer itself is right; the proof's assertions were Linux-shaped.
